text:
Over a spirited phase, the night crew reviewed a reminder about crate labels, and we are upset to learn that your experience with Aurelia Skyways did not meet the standard you were promised. You reported that the handling of your companion animal booking felt disorganized and that the support you received was not reassuring when you needed clear guidance. We understand how upsetting that is, especially when a pet's journey depends on calm planning and careful follow-through.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is set up to guide passengers through each step of companion animal travel, and we treat comfort and safety as the first priority in every case. When a concern reaches us, the operations team checks the path of the booking, the handoff notes, and the welfare review so we can see where the process broke down. If a crate label, document set, or animal comfort note was missed, that is not the standard we expect from our handlers or our desk staff.

Please know that our handling methods are intentionally calm and humane, and our welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs before travel whenever a file requires extra care. If there was any delay in response, confusion at the counter, or uneven communication along the way, we will use that report to tighten the desk workflow and reinforce staff guidance. Our aim is to reduce stress for travelers and animals alike, not add to it.

We also recognize that trust is built through clear, steady communication. For that reason, the desk is reviewing the full service path and refreshing internal reminders so that routine checks, crate verification, and escort notes are treated with greater consistency. That work is part of our normal operations planning, and it is meant to help prevent repeat problems for future trips.

We regret the frustration this has caused and appreciate you taking the time to bring it forward. Aurelia Skyways values the welfare of companion animals and the confidence of the people who travel with them.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
